who_has_access.question: Who has access to the personal data?

options.label: External co-workers/collaborators inside the EU/EEA
options.description: Employees of other institutions that have formalised cooperation with the data controller, or employees of other institutions that are joint data controllers.

options.label: Data processor
options.description: For example, providers of external, online services or cloud storage, or a translator. NB! There must be a data processor agreement or other legal agreement between the data controller and the data processor.

options.label: Others with access to personal information

third_country_transfer.question: Will personal data be transferred to a third country?
third_country_transfer.help_text: A transfer to a third country occurs when personal data physically leave the EU/EEA or are accessible to individuals located outside the EU/EEA.

legal_basis.question: On what legal basis will the collected personal data be transferred?
options: Decision on adequate level of protection (Art. 45(3))
